transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad, and it just feels like I'm stuck in a dark place. This has been going on continuously for about five months now. That's why I finally decided to come to the clinic today.
During these five months, have you experienced any periods where your mood significantly improved, or where you felt abnormally happy, irritable, or energetic?
No, I haven't had any periods like that at all. My mood has just been consistently low and heavy, and I haven't felt energetic or happy even for a single day.
Have you experienced any unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others don't, or had any thoughts that seemed unreal or detached from reality during this time?

Yes, I actually have. Lately, I've been hearing faint whispering and voices when I'm completely alone in the room. I also constantly feel like people on the street are watching me and talking about me, which only started since I've been feeling this depressed.
Did the voices, whispering, or feelings of being watched start at the same time as your depressive symptoms, or did they begin before or after your depression started?

The deep sadness and depression definitely started first, about five months ago. The voices and the feeling of being watched only began after I was already feeling deeply depressed. They didn't start until a few weeks into this dark period.
Can you estimate how long you've been experiencing these voices and feelings of being watched, and have they been constant since they started or have they varied in intensity or frequency?

I've been dealing with them for about four months, starting shortly after this deep depression took over. They only happen during this dark period, and they aren't always constant; some days the voices and the feeling of being watched are much stronger and more intense than others.
Have you ever experienced a period where the voices or feelings of being watched occurred without the depressive symptoms, or have they always been present together?
No, they have never happened when my mood was normal. The voices and the feeling of being watched only occur when I am feeling deeply depressed, and they are always tied to this dark period.

Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you experienced the voices or feelings of being watched without any significant depressive symptoms, or have the psychotic symptoms always been accompanied by depression?

No, I have never experienced those things without the depression. They only ever happen when I am feeling deeply depressed. I've never had a single day where I heard voices or felt watched when my mood was normal.
Can you confirm that your current episode of depression, including the psychotic symptoms, has lasted continuously for about five months without any significant improvement in your mood?

Yes, I can confirm that. Both this heavy depression and the strange experiences have been going on continuously for the past five months. There hasn't been any real improvement in my mood at all during this entire time.

For a diagnosis, I need to understand if there have been any periods in the past where you experienced significant depressive or manic episodes, or any psychotic symptoms, outside of this current five-month period?

No, I have never experienced anything like this before this current five-month period. I have never had a manic episode or struggled with depression in the past, and these unusual experiences only happen when I am feeling depressed. This is the first time in my life I've ever dealt with these issues.
Is there anything else you would like to discuss or any questions you have regarding your condition or the next steps in your care?
I don't have any other specific questions right now. I just really want to find a way to start feeling better and get some help with this heavy weight.
